Jules (CSM): Heads-up: SilverStream flagged in today's churn scan. Active keys down ~62% over 8 days; primary champion moved. Need quick triage.
Kai (AM): Yikes. Any error spikes or just quiet?
Jules (CSM): Mostly quiet. Route-level drop on /v1/normalize; embeddings down ~40%.
signal-bot: Alert: customer_id=silverstream usage below 30-day baseline (auto).
Ravi (SE): Can you paste the quick query you used? I'll check cache hits and auth patterns.
Jules (CSM): SQL I ran:
```sql
SELECT route, date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, count(*) as calls
FROM requests
WHERE customer_id='silverstream' AND ts >= now() - interval '10 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY day DESC;
```
Tess (Solutions Eng): Suggestion: offer a 10-day sandbox + 1:1 enablement for their new ML lead. Also prep diagnostics runbook.
Kai (AM): Procurement mentioned a competitor demo last week in notes. Might be re-eval.
Ravi (SE): Quick check: no model fallbacks or server latency issues. KV cache hit rate dropped 80%->15% between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-08  likely client-side change.
Jules (CSM): That matches their billing note about unexpected tokens. I'll DM them offering sandbox and runbook.
Tess (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a 20-min workshop: batching, cache tips, and sample config (ETA 24h).
Kai (AM): I'll flag CRM: "champion-moved" and add the renewal play: "sandbox+workshop".
Jules (CSM): Actions: 1) Ravi full log audit (ETA 2h) 2) Tess workshop (24h) 3) Kai schedule QBR & update CRM 4) Jules reach out with sandbox offer.
Ravi (SE): FYI: found repeated token-refresh churn in logs (many short-lived keys). Will include sample request_ids in audit.
Jules (CSM): Good catch. That explains both dip and token burn. I'll call them this afternoon and update here. :thumbsup:
